contents: Publisher version of record, 17 pp. Review article. Section 'Deterministic models of within-host Mtb dynamics' restates the Antia, Koella & Perrot (1996) within-host mycobacterial model as Equations 1-3 (short-term dynamics: replicating pathogen P, dormant pathogen Q, immune response X) and the Hayflick-limit T-cell extension as Equations 4-6. Equations 7-9 are the Gill/McDaniel plasmid-segregation model. MODEL_EQUATIONS.md holds the transcribed equations and the parameter-provenance sentence.
why: Independent, citable confirmation that the canonical within-host mycobacterial persistence model (Antia 1996) was parameterised ad hoc and never fitted to data - stated in print by Ganusov, who works in this exact modelling area. Supports the argument that dormancy/reactivation rate constants in this lineage carry no empirical calibration.
